title: Add logo to dashboard and apply gradient styling

requirements.text: Display the LivSpan logo (IMG_8398-1.png) in the top left corner of the dashboard page, matching the styling and placement used on the login page

quotes: Das Logo von der Anmeldeseite jetzt auch auf dem Dashboard oben links anbringen

acceptanceCriteria: Logo appears in top left corner of StartDashboard page
Logo uses the same IMG_8398-1.png asset as the login page
Logo styling matches the login page implementation

requirements.text: Apply a bright green gradient effect to all page headings across the application

quotes: Überschriften der Seiten im leuchtenden grünen Farbverlauf

acceptanceCriteria: All page headings use a luminous green gradient
Gradient is consistent across all pages
Text remains readable against the background

requirements.text: Style the fasting timer number line display with a green-to-blue gradient effect

quotes: Zahlenstrahl im grün - blauen Farbverlauf darstellen

acceptanceCriteria: The fasting timer number display uses a green-to-blue gradient
Gradient transitions smoothly from green to blue

constraints: Use the existing IMG_8398-1.png logo asset without modifications
Maintain existing DNA helix theme and color scheme
Do not modify immutable frontend paths including UI components, hooks, and main.tsx
nonGoals: Changing the backend logic or data structures
Adding new features beyond the specified visual updates
